tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification in development builds

TLS certificate verification is required in every build of this project, development builds included; it is not disabled or relaxed for development. This sits alongside the project's policy of https everywhere with no plaintext exception.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md
